lines.text: David asks the LORD to vindicate him and examine his heart, because he has walked with integrity.
David does not sit with deceitful men, and he hates the mob of evildoers.
David washes his hands in innocence to go about the LORD's ark and tell of all His wonderful works.
David loves the palace where the LORD dwells and asks not to be taken away with sinners.
David will walk with integrity, asks to be redeemed, and says he will bless the LORD in the congregations.
